title: Static Glucagon Secretion Analysis of Isolated Islets
author: Julien Ghislain
materials: Prepare KRB stocks, glucose and L-arginine solutions KRB stock I: weigh 27.7 g NaCl bring to 1 L with milliQ water KRB stock II: weigh 1.494 g CaCl 2 •2H 2 O and bring to 1 L with milliQ water KRB stock III: weigh 0.648 g KH 2 PO 4 and bring to 1 L with milliQ water KRB stock IV: weigh 1.415 g KCl, 1.17 g MgSO 4 •7H 2 O and 8.52 g NaHCO 3 and bring to 1 L with milliQ water 1 Molarity (M) Glucose: weigh 18.02 g and bring to 100 mL with milliQ water. Filter sterilize using a 0.2 μm filter.
Radioimmunoassay kits are used to measure glucagon levels. Several kits are available from MilliporeSigma. For the protocol please refer to the manufacturer's instruction.

steps.title: Prepare Base KRB Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the base KRB solution by combining equal volumes of four KRB stock solutions in a beaker to achieve the required total volume.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.38 mg/mL HEPES powder and swirl to dissolve.
Add 1 mg/mL BSA (fatty acid free) without mixing.
Cover with plastic wrap (with holes in top) and incubate at 37 °C for > 1 hour.
Adjust the solution to pH 7.35 using 1 M NaOH (starting pH is approximately 7.2).

steps.title: Prepare Specific KRB Conditions
steps.instruction: Prepare the different glucose and arginine concentrations in KRB based on the required volumes for pre-incubation, picking, and static assays.

substeps.instruction: For 5.5 mM Glucose condition: Add 5.5 µL of 1 M Glucose per mL of KRB (calculate volume for two pre-incubations at 1 mL/well, plus 1 mL/well and ~70 mL for picking/washing).
For 1 mM Glucose condition: Add 1 µL of 1 M Glucose per mL of KRB (calculate volume for static incubation at 1 mL/well).
For 1 mM Glucose + 10 mM L-arginine condition: Add 1 µL of 1 M Glucose per mL of KRB, then add L-arginine powder (1.75 mg/mL) and adjust pH to 7.35 with HCl.
Note: If adding fatty acids, prepare the KRB solution without BSA.

steps.title: Prepare Incubation Plates
steps.instruction: Set up 24-well plates for the different stages of the assay and place them in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Islet picking plates: Add 1 mL of 5.5 mM Glucose KRB to three wells per static sample.
Pre-incubation plates: Prepare two separate plates, each with 1 mL of 5.5 mM Glucose KRB in three wells per static sample.
Static incubation plate: Add 1 mL of experimental KRB (either 1 mM glucose alone or 1 mM glucose + 10 mM L-arginine) to three wells per static sample.

steps.title: Islet Recovery and Picking
steps.instruction: Recover isolated islets and distribute them into the picking plates.

substeps.instruction: Allow islets to recover in recovery medium (RPMI / 10% serum / 11.1 mM glucose) for 1 hour at 37 °C.
Wash islets in a petri dish containing 20 mL of 5.5 mM Glucose KRB.
Pick islets in triplicate batches of 10 into the islet picking plate wells.

steps.title: Sequential Islet Incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer islets through the pre-incubation and static incubation stages at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer islets from picking plate to the first pre-incubation plate; incubate for 20 minutes.
Transfer islets to the second pre-incubation plate; incubate for 20 minutes.
Transfer islets to the static incubation plate; incubate for 1 hour.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: Collect secreted glucagon from the media and islets for content analysis.

substeps.instruction: During static incubation, label two 1.5 mL tubes per sample for media collection and prepare 1.5 mL tubes filled with 1 mL acidified ethanol (75% v/v ethanol / 1.5% v/v HCl).
At the end of static incubation, transfer islets to the acidified ethanol tubes, cap, and store at -20 °C overnight.
Transfer media from each static incubation well into 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes, transfer supernatant to new 1.5 mL tubes, and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Process Glucagon Content Samples
steps.instruction: Process the islet content samples the following day.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve the glucagon content analysis tubes (islets in acidified ethanol), vortex, and centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to labeled 1.5 mL tubes and store at -20 °C until the assay is completed.
